text: I had my routine work done at this dental clinic last time when I visited Thailand from USA. The dentist was so gentle with her work and the staff were so friendly. I could easily get to the clinic easily by BTS. It cost me only a fraction of what I would have paid to get the same quality work done in USA. I will be using their service again next time I am visiting Thailand.😻

A dental clinic on the second floor of the Phahonyothin Place building, on the plaza side, and a long-standing establishment.
I used to work in this building, requiring a regular office visit, and I still visit occasionally. Since I started working here, I've been going back every year. The dentists are excellent, removing tartar and filling.
I'm covered under social security at 900 baht.
I pay an additional 300-400 baht for tartar removal or filling myself.
The building has parking, so you can park for free for one hour.
Appointments are required, and it's easy.
Call the clinic directly.
The clinic is clean and has a vintage decor, but the doctor and assistants are very experienced. 💕 …

I've been using this clinic's services for over 10 years. I've had dental implants, crowns, root canal treatment, and more.
The specialist and general dentists are highly skilled and explain everything to patients in detail.
The clinic uses high-quality materials for patients, and I've never had any problems with any of the treatments I've had.
The counter staff and assistants are also polite and friendly. I'm very impressed with this place and use their services every time I have the opportunity to visit Thailand.
Perfect! Highly recommended! The doctor is very skilled and gentle. After the procedure, I can chew food much better...and it's not painful anymore. All the doctors here are professionals.

The doctor was very polite. All the nurses were lovely and gave good advice on what to do.
I had a wisdom tooth extracted. The doctor had a very gentle hand.
